text:
jia: Quick follow-up from the RFC brainstorming  proposing we split quantization profile surface into a tiny hot-path `runtime_hints` and a heavyweight cold-path `safety_contract`. goal: keep per-request parsing tiny for fp8/int8/4bit lanes and push verification to async/cached flows.

nate: clarifying q: are hints authoritative or advisory? if advisory, runtime must have deterministic fallback ordering.

jia: advisory but with a trust handshake. hints carry `contract_digest` + `hint_version`; runtime accepts hint only if digest matches local trusted contract or if the hint is labeled `trusted: true` by ops (rare). otherwise runtime falls back to conservative lane (e.g., int8-stable).

alex: this trust model sounds fine but we need a safety net for silent quality regressions. propose emitting `degradation_score` per request when using hints and a rolling alert when average crosses threshold. also add per-lane per-model quality anchors.

tanya: for audits, `safety_contract` must be immutable and signed. require fields: `signed_by`, `signature`, `effective_from`, and an append-only `contract_log`. security will refuse unsigned contracts for enterprise tenants.

sam: ops datapoint  full contracts in 99th percentile payloads add ~100-150ms at the edge and increase GC churn in our hot threads. dropping to a ~16-64 byte hint saves a lot. also simplifies CDN cache keys.

jia: example compact hint we discussed: ```json {"hint_version":"v1","lane":"fp8-fast","max_seq":2048,"allowed_deg_pct":0.75,"fallback_priority":2,"contract_digest":"sha256:deadbeef","hint_ttl_secs":300} ```

nate: include `fallback_priority` please so runtime can try fallback lanes in a deterministic order without contacting store. also include a tiny `prov` field to identify producer.

alex: compatibility question  runtimes should accept both legacy full-contract-only profiles and the new dual-surface. suggest `profile_mode` enum: `legacy|dual|hints_only` so we can roll out gradually.

jia: agreed. default to `legacy` when `runtime_hints` absent. rollout plan: produce hints, enable `dual` on 5% of hosts, monitor `hint_accepted` vs `contract_checked` ratios and deg metrics, then expand.

tanya: telemetry plan: emit events `hint_used`, `hint_rejected`, `contract_fetched`, `deg_alert`. attach metadata: `model`, `lane`, `seq_len_bin`, `request_id`. also add histogram for response-quality delta versus baseline.

sam: implementation note  profile store can expose a `GET /contracts?digest=<sha256>` endpoint with cache-control headers. make the store tolerant to slightly different JSON ordering by normalizing before digesting.

jia: good point. we'll spec canonical JSON + sha256. security wants signature over canonical bytes.

alex: micro-optimization idea: for top 3 lanes we could define a 1-byte enum encoding for hints to avoid JSON parse cost. not necessary for initial rollout but add to spec as future compact encoding.

jia: summary of minimal API changes: 1) add `runtime_hints` object into profiles; 2) require `contract_digest`, `hint_version`, `fallback_priority`, `hint_ttl_secs`; 3) require signed `safety_contracts` for enterprise; 4) profile store supports fetch-by-digest; 5) telemetry events listed above.

nate: testing checklist: synthetic A/B: hint-only vs full-contract for latency, quality metrics (perplexity/deg score), and rollback behavior. measure canary at 1%, 5%, 20%.

tanya: security checklist: canonicalization for signing, replay protection for hints (hint_ttl), audit log retention policy.

sam: ops rollout steps: 1) producers start emitting hints; 2) enable `dual` on canary hosts and record `hint_used` counts; 3) if deg delta < threshold, enable `hints_only` on low-risk endpoints (e.g., non-sensitive models); 4) wide rollout. include kill-switch via config flag.

deploy-bot: New RFC created: /rfc/quant-hint-contract-surface (auto) Link: https://rfc.internal/quant-hint-contract-surface

jia: I'll draft the RFC with payload examples, canonicalization rules, canary metrics, and rollback playbook. action items: jai to draft RFC (EOD), sam to run synthetic bench, nate to spec fallback_priority telemetry, alex to draft compatibility shim notes. pls react with :thumbsup: if okay.
